# Analysis Console Interface
The [bold]Analysis Console[/bold] is used to view and manage artifact nodes.
## Node Information - [bold]ID:[/bold] Unique identifier, shown by the Node Scanner during activation. - [bold]Class:[/bold] The node’s layer. Nodes on the same layer share the same class. - [bold]Status:[/bold] - [italic][color=red]Locked[/color][/italic] – default state. - [italic][color=plum]Active[/color][/italic] – unlocked by triggers; can be manually activated. - [italic][color=lime]Unlocked[/color][/italic] – revealed when progressing deeper; cannot be manually activated. - [bold]Durability:[/bold] Number of manual activations left. - [bold]Effect:[/bold] What happens when the node activates. - [bold]Triggers:[/bold] Required actions to activate the node the first time. - [bold]Server/Extraction:[/bold] Choose a research server and extract points from unlocked nodes.
